BrochureContent.Content:
** Detached Bungalow on 5.1 acres **
** Sand Arena and Stable Block **
** Idyllic Countryside Location **
** Sun drenched west facing BBQ area **


At Byrne Malone, we take great pride in selling unique homes, and Slate House is a truly superb example! A modern, comfortable residence complemented by an exceptional equestrian setup on approximately 5.1 acres of beautifully arranged paddocks, all set within an idyllic countryside location.

Slate House offers the ultimate lifestyle appeal in so many aspects. Both the house and grounds have been thoughtfully maintained by its current owners, creating an immediate sense of privacy and tranquillity. Internally, the home extends to approx. 165 sq.m approx. of bright, generously proportioned accommodation throughout. Both front and rear of the property enjoy views across the surrounding paddocks and countryside beyond, creating a wonderful connection between the home and land. 

The property is approached via an attractive tree-lined tarmac driveway with parking for multiple vehicles. This leads directly to the yard and equestrian facilities, allowing excellent functionality for those with horses or general smallholding interests. Entering the home itself, you are greeted by a beautifully floored hallway off which you have a spacious formal sitting room complete with a fuel-burning stove keeping the space cosy throughout the winter! On from here the kitchen / living area is the heart of this home, thoughtfully designed with functionality and style in mind, complemented by a large utility room providing ample storage. The living portion of this space is the owner?s favourite spot to curl up with a good book, and it is also ideal for family gatherings as it opens into the decking area creating the perfect flow for those who enjoy entertaining! 

What will also appeal to a multitude of buyers is the flexible bedroom accommodation. The main bedroom boasts an en-suite shower room and there is an additional double bedroom which interconnects to two further double bedrooms / home office spaces, offering the opportunity to be used whichever way its new owner desires! Across the hall are two further bedrooms, and completing the accommodation is a beautifully-appointed family bathroom, featuring a bath with shower, all finished with elegant tiling and fittings.

The gardens surrounding Slate House have been thoughtfully landscaped and exceptionally well maintained, creating a peaceful and private setting with beautiful views across the adjoining paddocks and surrounding countryside. Mature hedging, manicured lawns, specimen planting and attractive landscaped borders, are all carefully arranged to maximise privacy while taking full advantage of the property?s rural outlook. 

The lands at Slate House extend to approx. 5.1 acres / 2 hectares and are laid out in well maintained paddocks of quality grassland, offering excellent suitability for equestrian, hobby farming or general lifestyle use. The configuration of the lands allows for ease of management together with excellent accessibility throughout. 

The yard includes a stable block of four each fitted with water troughs, with an additional tack room, feed room and washdown area. A sand arena of 43 x 21 metres approx, is freshly laid in Wexford sand and positioned to the front of the stable block offering excellent potential for equestrian use. The overall setup will appeal strongly to those with equestrian interests seeking a manageable yet well-equipped country property within easy reach of the wider Leinster equestrian network.

In terms of wider amenity, just a ten-minute drive away there is the lovely country town of Rathangan, built on the banks of the Grand Canal and brimming with charm owing to its historical origins. Today it has every local convenience, including primary and secondary schools, shops, eateries and sporting facilities. For commuters, the town is well linked with convenient access to the M7 motorway along with Kildare, Monasterevin and Newbridge Train Stations all being within easy reach running regular services to Dublin Heuston, Connolly and beyond. For the ultimate retail therapy, Kildare Village retail outlet is close-by and Kildare Town itself is also home to most of the big name supermarkets. 

This stunning family home perfectly embodies countryside living, seamlessly combining contemporary amenities, and fantastic design suited to any age and stage of family. But don?t just take our word for it, reach out to us to arrange a viewing and let this exceptional home speak for itself!
